faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tezpur University IPR Chair Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Tezpur University IPR Chair Professor position is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the IPR Chair Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the IPR Chair Professor post at Tezpur University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The qualification includes being a Professor or Associate Professor with IPR experience, an IP attorney with 10 years of practice, or a retired IP Office official with a PhD and 5 years at Level 12 or above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IPR Chair Professor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the IPR Chair Professor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via Email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the IPR Chair Professor post is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IPR Chair Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting by a Screening Committee followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
